attractions.name: Hagia Sophia
attractions.description: Byzantine cathedral turned mosque — 1,500 years of empire under one vast dome.

attractions.name: Blue Mosque (Sultanahmet Camii)
attractions.description: Early-1600s imperial mosque famous for the blue İznik tiles lining its interior and six minarets.

attractions.name: Topkapı Palace
attractions.description: Sprawling court of the Ottoman sultans for 400 years, with treasury, harem and Bosphorus views.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: Four courtyards of palace complex plus the Harem and Treasury; the HISTORICAL default of 90 covers barely half of it.

attractions.name: Basilica Cistern
attractions.description: Vast 6th-century underground reservoir held up by 336 columns, two resting on Medusa heads.

attractions.name: Grand Bazaar
attractions.description: One of the world's oldest covered markets, a labyrinth of 4,000 shops selling carpets, gold and spices.

attractions.name: Galata Tower
attractions.description: Medieval Genoese stone tower whose top gallery offers a 360-degree panorama over the old city and Golden Horn.

attractions.name: Süleymaniye Mosque
attractions.description: Sinan's masterpiece mosque crowning a hill, with a serene courtyard and sweeping views of the Golden Horn.

attractions.name: Dolmabahçe Palace
attractions.description: Opulent 19th-century waterfront palace blending Ottoman and European styles, with a four-tonne crystal chandelier.

attractions.name: Spice Bazaar
attractions.description: Aromatic 17th-century market near Eminönü stacked with spices, Turkish delight, teas and dried fruit.

attractions.name: İstiklal Street & Taksim
attractions.description: Buzzing pedestrian boulevard lined with shops and cafes, running from Taksim Square down to Galata.

attractions.name: Hippodrome & Sultanahmet Square
attractions.description: Former Byzantine chariot-racing arena, now a square holding the Egyptian Obelisk and Serpent Column.

attractions.name: Chora Church (Kariye)
attractions.description: Small Byzantine church preserving some of the finest medieval mosaics and frescoes in the world.

attractions.name: Brandenburg Gate
attractions.description: Neoclassical 18th-century gate topped by a chariot, the enduring symbol of a once-divided, now-reunited Berlin.

attractions.name: Reichstag Building
attractions.description: Seat of the German parliament crowned by Norman Foster's glass dome, which visitors can climb for city views.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: Security screening, the lift and the dome ramp; the dome's own audioguide runs 20 minutes (bundestag.de, retrieved 2026-08-18) before the queue at either end.

attractions.name: Museum Island
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed cluster of five world-class museums on the Spree, home to the Pergamon Altar and Nefertiti bust.

attractions.name: Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe
attractions.description: Field of 2,711 grey concrete stelae of varying heights forming a stark, disorienting Holocaust memorial.

attractions.name: East Side Gallery
attractions.description: Longest surviving stretch of the Berlin Wall, painted by artists into a 1.3 km open-air mural gallery.

attractions.name: Berlin Wall Memorial — Bernauer Straße
attractions.description: Preserved section of the wall with watchtower and death strip, documenting the city's Cold War division.

attractions.name: Checkpoint Charlie
attractions.description: Famous Cold War crossing point between East and West Berlin, marked by a reconstructed guard booth.

attractions.name: Berliner Dom
attractions.description: Grand Baroque-revival Protestant cathedral on Museum Island with a climbable dome over the Spree.

attractions.name: TV Tower — Alexanderplatz
attractions.description: At 368 m the tallest structure in Germany, with an observation deck and revolving restaurant.

attractions.name: Tiergarten
attractions.description: Berlin's largest central park, a sprawling green expanse of woodland paths, lakes and the Victory Column.

attractions.name: Charlottenburg Palace
attractions.description: Largest Prussian palace in Berlin, with Baroque state rooms and formal landscaped gardens.

attractions.name: Gendarmenmarkt
attractions.description: Elegant square framed by the twin German and French cathedrals and the colonnaded Konzerthaus.

attractions.name: Old Town Market Square
attractions.description: Heart of the meticulously rebuilt Old Town, ringed by colourful burgher houses and a mermaid statue.

attractions.name: Royal Castle
attractions.description: Former residence of Polish kings, destroyed in WWII and faithfully reconstructed with restored state rooms.

attractions.name: Łazienki Park
attractions.description: Warsaw's grandest park, with the Palace on the Isle, peacocks and a monument to composer Chopin.

attractions.name: Warsaw Uprising Museum
attractions.description: Immersive museum chronicling the 1944 revolt against Nazi occupation through artefacts and recreated streets.

attractions.name: POLIN Museum of the History of Polish Jews
attractions.description: Award-winning museum tracing a thousand years of Polish-Jewish life, set on the former ghetto grounds.

attractions.name: Palace of Culture and Science
attractions.description: Towering Stalinist-era skyscraper, Poland's tallest building, with a 30th-floor observation terrace.

attractions.name: Wilanów Palace
attractions.description: Lavish Baroque royal palace, often called the Polish Versailles, set amid formal gardens.

attractions.name: Copernicus Science Centre
attractions.description: Hands-on science museum on the Vistula riverbank with hundreds of interactive exhibits and a planetarium.

attractions.name: Krakowskie Przedmieście
attractions.description: Elegant Royal Route boulevard lined with palaces, churches and the University of Warsaw.

attractions.name: Holy Cross Church
attractions.description: Baroque church on the Royal Route holding an urn with Chopin's heart, sealed within a pillar.

attractions.name: Warsaw Barbican
attractions.description: Semicircular brick fortification of the medieval city walls, rebuilt as a gateway between Old and New Towns.

attractions.name: Hungarian Parliament Building
attractions.description: Vast neo-Gothic parliament on the Danube, the largest building in Hungary, holding the crown jewels.

attractions.name: Buda Castle
attractions.description: Historic hilltop palace complex of Hungarian kings, now housing the National Gallery and city views.

attractions.name: Fisherman's Bastion
attractions.description: Whimsical neo-Romanesque terrace of turrets on Castle Hill framing postcard views across the Danube.

attractions.name: Matthias Church
attractions.description: Ornate Gothic church with a vivid tiled roof where Hungarian kings were crowned.

attractions.name: St. Stephen's Basilica
attractions.description: Grand neoclassical basilica housing the mummified hand of Hungary's first king and a panoramic dome.

attractions.name: Széchenyi Chain Bridge
attractions.description: Stately 19th-century suspension bridge guarded by stone lions, the first permanent span across the Danube here.

attractions.name: Széchenyi Thermal Baths
attractions.description: Grand neo-Baroque spa complex with steaming outdoor pools, Europe's largest medicinal thermal bath.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: A bathing visit — changing, several indoor and outdoor pools. The LANDMARK default of 30 is a category mismatch rather than an estimate.

attractions.name: Heroes' Square
attractions.description: Monumental square anchored by the Millennium Memorial colonnade honouring Hungary's founding chieftains.

attractions.name: Great Market Hall
attractions.description: Cavernous three-floor covered market for paprika, sausages, langos and Hungarian crafts.

attractions.name: Gellért Hill & Citadella
attractions.description: Rocky hill topped by a fortress and the Liberty Statue, offering the city's broadest panorama.

attractions.name: Dohány Street Synagogue
attractions.description: Largest synagogue in Europe, a Moorish-revival landmark with a memorial garden to Holocaust victims.

attractions.name: Shoes on the Danube Bank
attractions.description: Haunting memorial of cast-iron shoes by the river honouring Jews shot here during WWII.

attractions.name: Tower of London
attractions.description: Nearly 1,000-year-old riverside fortress guarding the Crown Jewels, once a royal palace and prison.

visitMinutesProvenance.quote: We recommend allowing at least three hours, dependent on queues

attractions.name: Tower Bridge
attractions.description: Iconic Victorian bascule bridge over the Thames with twin towers and a high-level glass walkway.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: The hours encode the ticketed exhibition — high-level walkways and Victorian engine rooms — not the free crossing that LANDMARK's 30 would fit.

attractions.name: British Museum
attractions.description: Encyclopedic museum of world cultures holding the Rosetta Stone, Parthenon marbles and Egyptian mummies.

attractions.name: Westminster Abbey
attractions.description: Gothic abbey where English monarchs are crowned and buried, alongside poets and scientists.

attractions.name: Big Ben & Houses of Parliament
attractions.description: Neo-Gothic seat of UK government beside the Thames, fronted by the famous Elizabeth Tower clock.

attractions.name: Buckingham Palace
attractions.description: Official London residence of the British monarch, fronted by the daily Changing of the Guard.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: The operator publishes 1 hour 30 minutes for its winter guided tour (rct.uk, retrieved 2026-08-18); the summer self-guided State Rooms route the hours encode ends through the garden and runs longer.

attractions.name: London Eye
attractions.description: Giant 135 m observation wheel on the South Bank giving slow-turning views across the whole city.

attractions.name: National Gallery & Trafalgar Square
attractions.description: Free gallery of Western masterpieces from Van Gogh to Turner, overlooking lion-flanked Trafalgar Square.

attractions.name: St Paul's Cathedral
attractions.description: Wren's domed Baroque cathedral with a Whispering Gallery and far-reaching views from its upper galleries.

attractions.name: Hyde Park
attractions.description: Sprawling central royal park with the Serpentine lake, Speakers' Corner and open lawns.

attractions.name: Borough Market
attractions.description: Historic foodie market under railway arches packed with artisan produce, cheeses and street food.

attractions.name: Natural History Museum
attractions.description: Cathedral-like museum of the natural world famed for its dinosaur skeletons and ornate terracotta hall.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.description: Paris's 330 m wrought-iron icon, built for the 1889 World's Fair, with viewing decks over the city.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: A ticketed ascent by lift or stairs to two or three levels, with a queue at each; LANDMARK's 30 does not cover going up.

attractions.name: Louvre Museum
attractions.description: World's most-visited museum, home to the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo behind a glass pyramid.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: The largest art museum in the dataset by a wide margin; 120 minutes is spent mostly reaching the headline works through the crowds.

attractions.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
attractions.description: Medieval Gothic masterpiece on the Île de la Cité, famed for its flying buttresses and rose windows.

attractions.name: Sacré-Cœur & Montmartre
attractions.description: White-domed hilltop basilica above the artsy Montmartre quarter, with sweeping views over Paris.

attractions.name: Arc de Triomphe
attractions.description: Monumental triumphal arch honouring Napoleon's armies, with a rooftop terrace over twelve radiating avenues.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: The hours encode the rooftop climb — a spiral staircase to the terrace and back — rather than the monument seen from the roundabout that LANDMARK's 30 fits.

attractions.name: Champs-Élysées
attractions.description: Grand tree-lined avenue of cafes, flagship shops and theatres running to the Arc de Triomphe.

attractions.name: Musée d'Orsay
attractions.description: Former Beaux-Arts railway station holding the world's finest collection of Impressionist masterpieces.

attractions.name: Sainte-Chapelle
attractions.description: Royal Gothic chapel renowned for its towering walls of 13th-century stained glass.

attractions.name: Luxembourg Gardens
attractions.description: Elegant formal gardens around the Luxembourg Palace, with fountains, statues and sail-boat ponds.

attractions.name: Panthéon
attractions.description: Neoclassical mausoleum in the Latin Quarter where Voltaire, Curie and other French luminaries rest.

attractions.name: Trocadéro
attractions.description: Terraced plaza across the Seine offering the classic head-on panorama of the Eiffel Tower.

attractions.name: Colosseum
attractions.description: Vast 1st-century amphitheatre where gladiators fought before crowds of 50,000, Rome's enduring emblem.

attractions.name: Roman Forum & Palatine Hill
attractions.description: Ruined heart of ancient Rome, a sprawl of temples and arches beside the hill where emperors lived.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: Two adjoining open-air archaeological areas on one ticket, both covered on foot; one HISTORICAL default of 90 models only one of them.

attractions.name: Pantheon
attractions.description: Best-preserved ancient Roman building, its vast unreinforced concrete dome open to the sky through an oculus.

attractions.name: Trevi Fountain
attractions.description: Theatrical Baroque fountain where visitors toss a coin over the shoulder to ensure a return to Rome.

attractions.name: Spanish Steps
attractions.description: Sweeping 18th-century stairway of 135 steps rising to the Trinità dei Monti church above.

attractions.name: Piazza Navona
attractions.description: Lively Baroque square built over a Roman stadium, centred on Bernini's Fountain of the Four Rivers.

attractions.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
attractions.description: Papal art collection culminating in Michelangelo's frescoed Sistine Chapel ceiling and Last Judgment.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: A one-way route through the papal galleries that only ends at the Sistine Chapel, with no short way through; the MUSEUM default of 120 leaves no time for the collections it passes.

attractions.name: St. Peter's Basilica
attractions.description: Monumental Renaissance basilica in Vatican City, with Michelangelo's dome and Pietà sculpture.

attractions.name: Castel Sant'Angelo
attractions.description: Cylindrical riverside fortress built as Hadrian's mausoleum, later a papal stronghold with rooftop views.

attractions.name: Galleria Borghese
attractions.description: Jewel-box villa gallery holding Bernini sculptures and Caravaggio paintings amid a leafy park.

attractions.name: Campo de' Fiori
attractions.description: Bustling square hosting a morning produce-and-flower market and a lively nightlife scene after dark.

attractions.name: Trastevere
attractions.description: Atmospheric riverside quarter of cobbled lanes, ivy-draped houses and traditional Roman trattorias.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: A neighbourhood walked through rather than a stop; LANDMARK's 30 fits a single sight.

attractions.name: Sagrada Família
attractions.description: Gaudí's still-unfinished basilica, a soaring forest of organic stone columns and luminous stained glass.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: A timed-entry ticketed basilica with an audio-guided interior visit, not a drop-in church; the RELIGIOUS default of 45 fits a parish church, not this.

attractions.name: Park Güell
attractions.description: Gaudí's whimsical hillside park of mosaic terraces, serpentine benches and gingerbread gatehouses.

attractions.name: Casa Batlló
attractions.description: Gaudí's fantastical townhouse on Passeig de Gràcia, with a scaly roof and bone-like balconies.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: A ticketed house-museum whose visit is an interior route over several floors to the roof terrace; LANDMARK's 30 fits a façade seen from the street.

attractions.name: Casa Milà — La Pedrera
attractions.description: Gaudí's wave-fronted stone apartment block crowned by a rooftop of sculptural chimneys.

visitMinutesProvenance.rationale: A ticketed interior visit through the apartment, attic exhibition and rooftop; LANDMARK's 30 fits the façade, which is not what the hours describe.

attractions.name: La Rambla
attractions.description: Famous tree-lined pedestrian boulevard threading from Plaça Catalunya down to the old harbour.

attractions.name: Gothic Quarter & Barcelona Cathedral
attractions.description: Medieval maze of narrow lanes and squares around a Gothic cathedral with a cloister of geese.

attractions.name: La Boqueria Market
attractions.description: Vibrant covered food market off La Rambla brimming with fruit, jamón, seafood and juice stalls.

attractions.name: Picasso Museum
attractions.description: Collection of over 4,000 works tracing Picasso's formative years, set in medieval Gothic mansions.

attractions.name: Montjuïc & Magic Fountain
attractions.description: Hilltop park with castle, gardens and city views above the choreographed Magic Fountain light shows.

attractions.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
attractions.description: Dazzling Modernista concert hall with a stained-glass skylight and richly ornamented mosaic interior.

attractions.name: Bunkers del Carmel
attractions.description: Former Civil War anti-aircraft battery on a hilltop, now the city's best 360-degree sunset viewpoint.

attractions.name: Barcelona Beach — Barceloneta
attractions.description: Golden city beach backed by the old fishermen's quarter, palm-lined promenade and seafood bars.
